id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting already retried 5xx 429 as tracked errors

review.posthog_relevance: Adds retryability for transient HTTP status errors and Cloudflare 52x/530 to the warehouse ingestion worker, potentially improving ingestion reliability and reducing false-positive failure tracking.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 introduces a new method `get_retryable_errors` that distinguishes transient HTTP status errors and Cloudflare 52x/530 from permanent errors like 401/403. This change enables the Temporal worker activity importing Convex warehouse data to automatically retry transient failures rather than treating them as permanent. review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a specific reliability improvement. However, the actual reduction in false-positive failures and the resulting improvement in ingestion reliability are not independently verified by the provided observations; these are potential benefits inferred from the code change. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning transient HTTP status errors and Cloudflare 52x/530, while retaining 401/403 and retention-window errors as non-retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Temporal worker activities importing Convex warehouse data to automatically retry transient server or rate-limit errors rather than treating them as permanent failures, potentially improving ingestion reliability and reducing false-positive failure tracking.
